## Workload

Daniel Roche completed 599 reads during the quarter. This work took 454 hours, representing a rate of 1.3 reads per hour. The workload was reviewed in the context of the time recorded and the volume of reads completed.

## Quality

A total of 44 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The agreement rate was 72.7 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistency in assessment and interpretation.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
